description: This file defines an Angular service called ApiClient that provides methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to a backend API. It uses Angular's HttpClient and environment configuration for the base URL.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A service class facilitating HTTP communication with a backend API, encapsulating common HTTP methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request against the backend API with specified path and options.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with specified path, request body, and options.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with specified path, request body, and options.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request with specified path and options.
